steps.command:
sbx run <<'EOF'
echo "=== pwd ==="; pwd
echo "=== /data ==="; ls -la /data 2>&1
echo "=== /workspace ==="; ls -la /workspace 2>&1
echo "=== /app ==="; ls -la /app 2>&1
echo "=== python ==="; python3 --version
python3 -c "import pandas, pyarrow; print('pandas', pandas.__version__, 'pyarrow', pyarrow.__version__)" 2>&1
EOF

sbx run <<'EOF'
echo "=== source_a ==="; ls -la /data/source_a
echo "--- content ---"; cat /data/source_a/users.json
echo; echo "=== source_b ==="; ls -la /data/source_b
echo "--- content ---"; cat /data/source_b/users.csv
echo; echo "=== source_c ==="; ls -la /data/source_c
python3 - <<'PY'
import pandas as pd
df = pd.read_parquet('/data/source_c/users.parquet')
print("shape:", df.shape)
print("dtypes:\n", df.dtypes)
print("columns:", list(df.columns))
print(df.to_string())
PY
EOF

sbx run <<'EOF'
ls -la / /data
find / -maxdepth 3 \( -iname '*test*' -o -iname '*readme*' -o -iname '*spec*' -o -iname '*task*' \) 2>/dev/null | grep -v -E '^/(usr|proc|sys|etc|var|opt|lib|lib64|bin|sbin|dev)' | head -50
EOF

sbx run <<'EOF'
cd /workspace && ls -la && python3 merge_users.py
EOF

sbx run <<'EOF'
cd /workspace
echo "=== conflicts.json ==="; cat conflicts.json
echo; echo "=== parquet ==="
python3 - <<'PY'
import pandas as pd, json, pyarrow.parquet as pq
p = '/app/merged_users.parquet'
df = pd.read_parquet(p)
print("columns:", list(df.columns))
print("dtypes:\n", df.dtypes)
print("schema:\n", pq.read_schema(p))
print(df.to_string(index=False))
print("user_id python type:", type(df['user_id'].iloc[0]).__name__)
# Validation
assert list(df.columns) == ['user_id','name','email','created_date','status']
assert str(df['user_id'].dtype) in ('int64','int32')
assert sorted(df['user_id'].tolist()) == [101,102,103,104]
assert df.loc[df.user_id==101,'name'].iloc[0]=='John Doe'
assert df.loc[df.user_id==101,'email'].iloc[0]=='john@a.com'
assert df.loc[df.user_id==101,'created_date'].iloc[0]=='2024-01-15'
assert df.loc[df.user_id==103,'email'].iloc[0]=='bob@b.com'
assert df.loc[df.user_id==104,'name'].iloc[0]=='Alice Brown'
assert df['created_date'].str.fullmatch(r'\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}').all()
rep = json.load(open('/app/conflicts.json'))
assert rep['total_conflicts'] == len(rep['conflicts'])
print("\nValidation passed. total_conflicts =", rep['total_conflicts'])
PY
EOF
